text: My listening history is filling up while I'm asleep, and the speaker listed as playing is one I've never owned. I thought my session had just glitched until it started happening every night.
Oops. The screenshot I posted publicly included the sign-in details I use for Spotify. I've removed the picture, but people had already opened it. What should happen next?

During my accessibility complaint, a Spotify representative said people with my disability shouldn't use the service. I want that discriminatory treatment investigated.
The subscription money went out after I'd ended the plan. Please credit that sum back to the card; I don't want another month added in its place.
I'm looking at my bank statement: the Spotify renewal was taken twice this morning. Where can I query those two entries?
Whoever staffs Spotify support is a pack of incompetent clowns. You lot couldn't organise a single playlist between you.
That's my last month with Spotify. I've lined up Deezer for payday because this queue behaviour has worn me down; I'm taking my listening there.
I've emailed your support address on Monday, Wednesday and Friday about the missing library. The replies still haven't restored it, and I am no further forward.

Explain how to put a playlist in date-added order. And tell the idiots on your support desk to stop wasting everyone's time with their stupid replies.
Where can I compare the advertised student and individual plans? My college name was rejected on my application, so I'd also like you to approve my own student status manually.
The music stops when I move from headphones to the kitchen speaker. I can tell you the device details, but please put an actual support person in this conversation with me.

Your last reply got the missing albums back, cheers! One unrelated question before I go: is there a public explanation of what the download indicator means?

My playlist used to keep the newest additions at the top. Now the order changes when I reopen it, and I can't find the control I used before.

There are two different names for me on Spotify and I want the old one changed. I'm unsure whether the name I'm seeing is the login identifier or the public profile name.
When I open my account it looks different from yesterday. A few settings seem changed, but I don't know whether that's the update or someone else's doing.
I'm budgeting for next term and want the student plan's advertised price. Which details would you need to point me to the right public price page?
An item in my library just says 'unavailable'. I don't remember whether I saved it from the catalogue or imported it myself, and I haven't tried opening it anywhere else.
